messages:
sasha: Quick heads-up — kicking off a small canary for a sticky-sample mode on the request sampler for /v2/generate. Console rollout flag: `sampler.sticky_v1 = true` for 5% of traffic. Please watch sampling metrics and inspector traces.
jamie: Nice, what's the sticky key? user_id or session_id?
miguel: Using session_id by default, with a fallback to hashed client_token. We decided session because it matches the console UX session filter.
sasha: Right. Config snippet: ```json
{
  "policy": "sticky",
  "key": "session_id",
  "ttl_secs": 86400
}
```
alex: Quick concern: if session_id can be user-supplied (web SDK), we risk identical session across tenants. Need tenant scoping in the hashing step.
kat: +1. Also can we make the console show both the effective sample rate and the sticky TTL? Current dashboard shows only a single "sampled" rate which is misleading.
sasha: Good call — adding tenant_id to hash and flagging mismatch in the telemetry. I'll push a patch to sampler-service.
inspector-bot: [deploy] sampler-service v3.4.1 started canary (5%) at 2024-11-02T15:12:35Z :rocket:
jamie: Saw initial traces — one oddity: inspector shows the request body in the sample event even when route-level redaction is enabled. Might be a race where redaction plugin runs after sampling.
miguel: Hmm. Sampler currently pulls the raw request to compute deterministic sticky assignment before redaction. We can compute the hash over extracted metadata only (session_id, tenant_id) and stop pulling raw body. Safer.
kat: Is that a breaking change for any consumers expecting request-body-based sticky behavior?
sasha: No consumers intentionally depended on body hashing AFAIK. We'll gate the change under `sampler.sticky_v1` and document in the rollout notes.
alex: For the console UX: propose two quick additions — 1) show "sticky key" field per route, 2) expose a histogram of sticky assignment churn (how often a session flips sample bucket). That will help detect TTL/consent problems.
jamie: Also add an alert if console-sampled-rate diverges >5% from telemetry-sampled-rate over a 10m window. We'll get noisy but worth it initially.
miguel: I'll add a telemetry counter for "sampler.assignment_source" (metadata|body) so we can A/B the change safely.
sasha: Plan: patch sampler to hash only metadata + tenant, update console metrics + add divergence alert, run canary for 24h, then promote to 25% if no PII leakage. Sound good?
kat: sgtm :+1:
alex: sgtm. Please include rollout doc and a short note in the ops runbook about how to force-unassign a session for debugging.
inspector-bot: [note] Added runbook link: https://go.redwood/sampler-rollout-ops
sasha: Thanks — I'll update the PR and ping when canary is up to 25%.
